summary: Iter83 Business refinements — comprehensive backend+frontend QA. Backend: iter83 focused suite 5/5 PASS (new /app/backend/tests/test_iter83_business_welcome.py) proving (a) first POST /api/business/subscription/activate creates exactly ONE db.email_events record with template='business_welcome' for that user, (b) GET /api/business/subscription returns started_at + renews_at + platform + price='$5.99/month', (c) a second activate call while status is still 'active' does NOT create a duplicate business_welcome record, (d) cancel + reactivate DOES emit a fresh business_welcome (because prev_status='cancelled'), (e) GET /api/control/businesses/{id} returns business.subscription, owner.admin_status, verifications[], events[], reviews[], audit[], emails[] (includes business_welcome) and average_rating. Regression: `pytest tests/test_business_platform.py tests/test_iter81_business_secure_link.py` = 15/15 PASS at 11.91s. Frontend mobile 390x844 (Playwright localStorage auth_token JSON-stringified): (1) Business Profile tab — ALL menu sections rendered (ACCOUNT, BUSINESS, SUBSCRIPTION, WEB ACCESS, SUPPORT & LEGAL, ACCOUNT SETTINGS, DANGER ZONE) with expected rows testID'd: biz-edit-profile, biz-menu-events, biz-menu-reviews, biz-menu-insights, biz-menu-notifications, biz-menu-plan, biz-open-dashboard, biz-copy-dashboard, biz-view-public, biz-logout, biz-delete-account. (2) /business-reviews shows exact empty-state text 'Reviews from confirmed attendees will appear here after your events.' (3) /business-subscription shows plan Orrbbit Business $5.99/month, Status Active card, Start Date 9/10/2026, Next Renewal 10/10/2026, Platform, Manage Subscription (bizsub-manage), Cancel Subscription (bizsub-cancel). API round-trip cancel→GET (status='cancelled')→activate=restore verified end-to-end (200 OK). (4) Business dashboard Home shows the four Quick Actions (Create Event/View Profile/Open Dashboard/View Reviews) AND Recent Activity section; tapping 'View Reviews' navigates to /business-reviews (URL confirmed). (5) create-event as BUSINESS user: banner 'BUSINESS HOSTED EVENT' present, selected category chip renders in cobalt blue, photo pickers cobalt (verified via screenshot); as PERSONAL demo user (kauri@intro.demo): banner flips to 'PERSONAL HOSTED EVENT', selected chip renders in orange (screenshot confirmed). Web /business/settings (1366x800) shows Notifications toggles (bizset-notif-events + 4 more toggles, 5 total), Sign Out (bizset-signout) and Delete Account row (bizset-delete). Web /business/subscription shows Started 9/10/2026, Renews 10/10/2026, Platform: Staged (pre-store), Manage Subscription + Cancel Subscription buttons. Full seed data teardown performed at end of run. Two testID naming mismatches vs spec identified (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.issue: TestIDs use raw labels with spaces (e.g. 'biz-quick-Create Event', 'biz-quick-View Reviews'). Spec / iter-83 acceptance asked for kebab-case slugs like 'biz-quick-create-event' and 'biz-quick-view-reviews'. Works but breaks the requested convention and any downstream Playwright script using the slug form. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(business)/index.tsx:132 — testID={`biz-quick-${q.label}`}

Duplicate testID 'bizsub-restore' — one rendered as the outline button (when !active) and a second rendered as a small link 'Restore Purchase' (when active). Two Pressables share the same testID; also showing 'Restore Purchase' while the subscription IS active is odd UX. Reference: /app/frontend/app/business-subscription.tsx:110 and :115.

Rows 'Open Business Dashboard' and 'Copy Dashboard Link' render (text visible in DOM) but do NOT expose the expected testIDs 'bizset-open-dashboard' / 'bizset-copy-dashboard'. Notification toggles + sign-out + delete testIDs are all present.

issues: Non-blocking console warnings (carried over): 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on web (should be boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' on the business home. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Low) Rename Quick Action testIDs from `biz-quick-${label}` (with spaces) to kebab slugs: biz-quick-create-event / biz-quick-view-profile / biz-quick-open-dashboard / biz-quick-view-reviews — matches spec and previously-published testID contract. /app/frontend/app/(business)/index.tsx:132.

(Low) Fix duplicate testID 'bizsub-restore' in /app/frontend/app/business-subscription.tsx — pick one Pressable for the Restore action, or rename the extra link to e.g. 'bizsub-restore-link'. Also consider hiding 'Restore Purchase' link while status is 'active' (redundant / confusing).
(Low) Add missing testIDs 'bizset-open-dashboard' and 'bizset-copy-dashboard' to the corresponding Web Access rows in /app/frontend/app/business/settings.tsx to match the spec's convention.
(Optional / cosmetic) Migrate remaining shadow* + props.pointerEvents to boxShadow + style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: business.py activate_subscription correctly gates the business_welcome email on `prev_status != 'active'` (line 418), so back-to-back activate calls don't duplicate the welcome. Verified with a 5-test pytest module.
business.py GET /subscription (line 388-401) now returns started_at + renews_at + platform + price + guidance + billing_pending_configuration — matches iter83 spec.

control_business_detail (line 590-616) returns owner.admin_status, subscription (inside business), verifications[], events[], reviews[], average_rating, audit[], emails[] — matches Control Centre business detail panel schema.

(business)/profile.tsx renders all seven menu sections and correctly wires biz-menu-* rows to /business-subscription, /business-reviews, /(auth)/business-setup, /(business)/insights, /(business)/notifications, /business/settings and openBusinessDashboard/copyBusinessDashboardLink from src/lib/businessLinks.ts. Sign Out and Delete Account rows both present with confirm-dialog.

business-subscription.tsx (line 86-100) renders the Start Date / Next Renewal / Platform key-value card driven by GET /api/business/subscription — verified populated (9/10/2026 / 10/10/2026 / Staged (pre-store)) once activate ran.
